articles.title: First MyMAP Grand Prix Awards honour motorcycle makers and models
articles.original_title: Majlis Penghargaan ‘Malaysia Motorcycle Assessment Program (MyMAP) Grand Prix Awards 2024’
articles.summary: MIROS, together with MARii and Etiqa Malaysia, held the first MyMAP Grand Prix Awards at Malaysia Autoshow 2024 in Serdang. Deputy Transport Minister Dato’ Haji Hasbi Habibollah presented recognition to manufacturers and models that stood out for improving motorcycle safety.
points: 19 awards were contested in three categories (Exceptional, Exemplary and Excellence), including top awards for Exceptional Motorcycle Manufacturer and Exceptional Motorcycle Model for 2021–2024.
Since the programme began in 2021, 28 models from seven brands had been assessed: 24 earned five stars, one earned four stars and the rest earned three.
Participation was opened to motorcycles above 250 cc and to all engine types, including electric, in mid-2023.

articles.title: All 12 Modenas models entered in MyMAP earn five stars
articles.original_title: 12 Motosikal Modenas Dianugerahkan Penarafan 5 Bintang MyMAP
articles.summary: MyMAP received twelve Modenas models for assessment, and every one of them earned five stars. The rating plaques were presented at Eang Chung Motor in Kuala Lumpur.
points: The models span scooter, touring, sport cruiser, naked and sport categories.
All twelve have disc brakes with front and rear ABS and LED lighting, and seven also have traction control.
Modenas also runs the Modenas Safety Riding Academy, which the release highlights as a good example of a rider support programme.

articles.title: MyMAP opens to motorcycles above 250 cc and all engine types
articles.original_title: MyMAP Fasa Kedua dan Ketiga Telah Dibuka untuk Penyertaan
articles.summary: From 3 July 2023, manufacturers of motorcycles above 250 cc, with petrol, hybrid or electric engines, could enter MyMAP. At that point nine models had already earned five stars.
points: Phase one was voluntary and limited to motorcycles of 250 cc and below; phase two covers motorcycles above 250 cc; phase three covers all types and power combinations.
MIROS said it opened phase three earlier than planned because it had received many applications from makers of high-powered and hybrid motorcycles.
The aim is to push safety technology from premium models down to basic and affordable ones.

articles.title: Aveta VADV 150 becomes the first hybrid motorcycle to earn five stars
articles.original_title: Motosikal Hibrid Pertama yang Mendapat Penarafan Lima Bintang – Aveta VADV 150
articles.summary: MyMAP announced a five-star rating for the Aveta VADV 150 Hybrid, described as Malaysia’s first smart hybrid scooter. The rating plaque was presented at Malaysia Autoshow 2023 at MAEPS Serdang.
points: The VADV 150 is a 149 cc automatic scooter that also carries an energy-efficient vehicle (EEV) rating.
It has ABS on both wheels, an adaptive front-lighting system and a tyre-condition indicator.
Front and rear video recorders are also fitted, which the release describes as an added safety and security feature.

articles.title: Modenas Ninja 250 ABS and Z250 ABS obtain 5-star rating in the MyMAP programme
articles.original_title: Modenas Ninja 250 ABS & Z250 ABS obtains 5-star rating in the MyMAP programme
articles.summary: MIROS awarded five stars to the Modenas Ninja 250 ABS and Z250 ABS after an assessment and audit at the Modenas plant in Gurun on 25 October 2022. Both models scored 4.78 out of 5.00 points.
points: Both models have dual-channel ABS and comply with the relevant UN regulations.
The Ninja 250 ABS and Z250 ABS scored 0.45 of 0.5 points for UN regulations and the full 1.5 points for conformity of production.
Modenas also provides safe-riding videos and brochures to its customers as its support programme.

articles.title: Three Yamaha models earn five stars, led by the YZF-R15M
articles.original_title: Yamaha YZF-R15M Memperoleh Markah Tertinggi dalam Program MyMAP
articles.summary: MIROS awarded five stars to three Yamaha motorcycles, the YZF-R15M, XMAX and NVX ABS, after an audit at the Hong Leong Yamaha complex on 15 June 2022. The YZF-R15M recorded the highest score under the MyMAP scoring scheme.
points: The audit covered assembly and testing, and all three models performed strongly on the four main criteria.
The YZF-R15M meets UN vehicle safety regulations and has dual-channel ABS.
Buyers of the new model are offered M-CRU membership, which includes free safe-riding training in defensive riding skills.

articles.title: WMOTO XTREME 150i and RT3 earn five stars
articles.original_title: MyMAP Menganugerahkan Penarafan Bintang kepada Dua Model Motosikal Jenama WMOTO
articles.summary: MyMAP announced five-star ratings for two Mforce Bike Holdings models, the WMOTO XTREME 150i and WMOTO RT3. Both are fitted with ABS on the front and rear wheels.
points: MIROS noted that most motorcycles of 250 cc and below in Malaysia lacked ABS, even though the technology has existed since 1988, so it promoted ABS first.
The MIROS Director-General said MyMAP aims to encourage safety technology that fits local conditions, and not only ABS.

articles.title: MyMAP launch: SYM VF3i 185 receives the first motorcycle star rating
articles.original_title: Pelancaran MyMAP: SYM Terima Anugerah Penarafan Bintang Motosikal Pertama
articles.summary: The SYM VF3i 185 by Mforce became the first motorcycle to receive a five-star rating under MyMAP, at the programme’s launch. MIROS and MARii presented the award.
points: MyMAP was created from MIROS’s experience in developing ASEAN NCAP and rates motorcycles from one to five stars.
Ratings come from four criteria: UNECE compliance, conformity of production, safety technology and a rider support programme.
The first phase was voluntary and limited to motorcycles of 250 cc and below, a class said to make up more than 90 per cent of the market.

articles.title: MIROS and MARii announce star ratings for motorcycles
articles.original_title: Penilaian Bintang untuk Motosikal sebagai Paradigma Baru Keselamatan Motosikal – Satu Kerjasama MIROS-MARii
articles.summary: MIROS and MARii announced that they would run the Malaysia Motorcycle Assessment Program, giving star ratings to motorcycles made in Malaysia, with a launch planned for the end of March 2021.
points: The programme was built on MIROS’s experience with MyVAP and ASEAN NCAP, and follows a January 2021 MoU between MIROS and MARii.
The four assessment criteria were announced, with braking systems singled out as a key safety feature.
Simulation studies on popular brands found that several models could reach five stars, and all Malaysian manufacturers were invited to take part.
